observations: Default JSON Int64 tokens already parse bounded UTF-8. Hooks already own their raw token text and must remain unchanged.
Large defaults reserve two magnitudes, reserve4bytes/token-byte scratch, decode UTF-8 to CLR text, invoke BigInteger.Parse and separately fund the retained integer.
GuardIntegerParseBytes has one remaining production caller: JSON. One internal infrastructure test also calls it.
R45 general parser is cancellable and admitted but its repeated radix-chunk multiply/add is not assumed faster than BCL decimal parsing at large lengths.
Native list/tuple iteration and fused cased whitespace splitting already exist; neither is selected as a missing optimization.
qualification: Source gate only; no prototype, timing or producer qualification.
